items.title: WHO chief visits Cuba as healthcare system deteriorates
items.summary: Analysts say fuel shortages blamed on US sanctions are worsening the crisis.

items.title: India: Report warns of deepening authoritarianism under Modi
items.summary: A Human Rights Watch report found that Modi's rule in India has eroded the rule of law and "systematically weakened institutions" meant to protect freedoms. Also, in Delhi a man injured nine police with a knife.

items.title: Mexico to try ‘El Chapo Isidro’ despite US extradition request
items.summary: Fausto Meza Flores faces drug trafficking and weapons charges after his capture in a violent Sinaloa operation.

items.title: Jensen Huang's surprise return to Nvidia sparks mixed reactions in Washington
items.summary: US President Donald Trump praised Nvidia's decision Monday to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, as Democratic leaders vowed investigations and prominent Republicans questioned whether his return posed a national security risk.

items.title: Excavator threatens sacred alpine lake in the Himalayas
items.summary: Footage of an excavator near Sheshnag Lake in India-administered Kashmir has sparked outrage.

items.title: UN chief calls for world to agree on AI oversight within a year
items.summary: Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has become increasingly vocal about AI as end of term nears.

items.title: তিন বাহিনীর বিশেষ যৌথ মহড়া দেখতে স্বর্ণদ্বীপে প্রধানমন্ত্রী
